purpose: Prevent an execution turn from returning control at an intermediate milestone while reversible authorized work remains.

execution.persists_until: bounded unit completed_verified, genuine blocker, or newer owner command

status_and_continue.persists_until: same boundary as execution after the concise status

keep_going.persists_until: owner-named boundary, genuine blocker, or newer owner command

get_ready.persists_until: preparation is complete; substantive implementation remains reserved

permitted_final_response_reasons: bounded unit is completed_verified and required successor selection is complete
a classified genuine blocker with current evidence survived reasonable recovery and blocks all authorized progress
the owner explicitly selected get_ready, status_only, or analysis_only
nonterminal_conditions: implementation exists but required validation has not passed
required CI or another asynchronous operation is queued or running
a pull request is open, ready, or awaiting merge
merge succeeded but canonical closeout or successor selection is pending
one meaningful substep or tool-call batch ended
a status summary could be written while execution authority remains

runtime_enforcement.merge_reserve_rule: Before an application merge, stage the cross-repository closeout and retain enough observable execution reserve to verify the merge, reconcile canonical state and select the strict successor. If a platform usage warning makes that reserve unavailable, leave the validated pull request open.
runtime_enforcement.environment_interruption_handoff: A verified platform usage ceiling may permit a truthful blocked handoff while pending authorized steps remain, but those steps must be preserved explicitly and resume before unrelated work.
runtime_enforcement.ephemeral_state_rule: Turn-state inputs are temporary execution evidence and are not committed as activity logs. Durable checkpoint updates remain milestone-only; an unexpected environment interruption after a merge requires a material handoff checkpoint.
